title: The Mighty Wrath of Safar
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu
Akbar, wa lillaahi 'l-hamd! Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alayka yaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen, Habeeb
ar-Rabbi 'l-`Alameen, Noor al-`Arshillah, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen. Yaa Rasoolullah! Yaa
Rabbee! Zidhu `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridhwaana. A`oodhu billahi min ashShaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Dastoor, yaa Sayyidee. Madad,
yaa RijaalAllah.
As-salaamu `alaykum, attenders here, from east to west, from north to south, everyone, everywhere. La
hawla wa la quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Adheem.
O Mankind! All of us on this planet are now in a very terrible position and now is the time the period of
Mankind on this planet is going to finish. wa li-kulli naqul haad, "For everything there is a limit." Here on
this planet the period of Mankind is also in limits; everyone has a limit and when it finishes they must be
taken away. And we have just reached the last point of limits appointed by heavenly power on this planet, and
it is (comparitively) like an atom, not only this world, but our solar system is also like an atom. Bigger than
that is our galaxy, which is also like an atom. And when we go deeper we may think that space is so huge. La
hawla wa la quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Adheem. Where is `abdul, (the) servant? You say! When I say

“space,” what is it? Who knows? Who knows space, where it begins, where it ends? That is like an atom, and
all life in it are like atoms. No one truly knows space; we are looking at something, but it is not really space, it
is the Dominions of Allah Almighty's Majestic Oceans that no one knows!
We are such small ones and for everything there is a limit appointed by the Lord of Creation. When did
Creation begin? It began from pre-Eternal. What is Eternal? What is pre-Eternal? What is Eternity? No one
knows. People now are running for something that is tasteless, for themselves, not using what they have been
granted by Allah Almighty. We have been granted understanding, but now Mankind is not running to
understand and know. They are like completely drunken ones, because they are losing the chance granted to
people only once. Here they come for understanding, but others occupy themselves with running after
physical pleasure. That desire belongs to our material being, and finally our physical being will be buried
from where it was taken and will be given back to the Earth.
A car cannot move by itself. A 2011 car is a new fashion car but it is in a showroom. We say, "Why are you not
running it?" They say, "We cannot, because we need a driver." Similarly, our bodies cannot move, cannot act,
and cannot understand without a commander. We are commanding a car and it functions by the driver's
command. Now we are also in need of a driver that may command and turn that car according to his
intention. For example, if I am going from here to London, Turkey, Hijaz, or to Asia, that car cannot move by
itself, but if one person is driving, he may program it to go where he asks. Without a driver or commander,
our physical being cannot do anything. You know a driver or commander is not the same Creation as a car; a
car is one thing and our soul is something else. Our souls are from Heavens and our bodies are from Earth.
We must leave our physical beings here and our souls are going up.
O People! It is enough that you are drunk, but try not to be cheated by Shaytan! Shaytan is making people not
to think on such realities, always saying, "Drink, drink, drink, drink more and enjoy more!" That is Shaytan's
mission; it is trying to cheat. That is its real being, given when Allah (swt) commanded him to make sajdah to
Adam (a). Shaytan ran away and said, "No! I am not making sajdah to that one." Allah Almighty said, "You
are free, O cursed one! Go away and try to do what you can to them." From that day Shaytan was full with
hatred for that command and said, "I am making them go on the wrong way. I will train them to not be Your
servants, but to be my servants!" From being with angels in Heaven came demon Shaytan, true? Allah
Almighty answered, "Do as you like! I am the Lord, and My command will continue, not yours!"

It is a big shame for Mankind that have been granted such honor, yet they are not thanking their Lord. They
are running after their worst enemy, the most cursed one. Up to today, Shaytan is saying to Mankind, "You
are powerful. I am teaching you every technology and with it you will be such powerful ones," and it is
permitted by Almighty Allah to teach Mankind everything. Mankind runs after shaytanic technology,
thinking, "We are able to do everything as we like. We are not in need of heavenly commands, we can do
everything through our technology." Shaytan's agents are not leaving Mankind to learn that there are two
kinds of powers: from Heavens and from Earth. Shaytan says, "Your power is now perfect and you can do
everything as you like, no other power can stop you!"
But now they are reaching that point when floods and natural disasters are beginning around the world.
Angels are saying to Mankind, “Where is your power? To where are you running? That is a very small flood,
only one heavenly drop makes you underwater. We are not ordering, 'O Continents! Get down a little bit.'
There is no need, but we are now using some drops from the power of Heavens and huge floods are coming.”
It is going to be like Atlantis, under the ocean. Yet people are not taking wisdom from that. They are saying,
"We can do this." You cannot do anything! Only one drop from Heavens is coming to show people that, “All
perfect power and perfect will is with us, not with you!” One angel may do this but people are not trying to
stop floods, they are only running away to find something to eat and drink. They are not saying, “O our Lord!
Only You can do, and only You can forgive us. You are merciful to Your weak servants. O our Lord! We are
weak servants, so grant us Your forgiveness.”
What we are speaking is happening now. Again Mt. Etna erupted in Italy. Fire is saying, "O People! Floods
are coming on you. Beware! Under you is fire and over you is water!" yet they are not thinking. No one is
saying anything, but it is a warning for all nations that no one can refuse. No one is going to mosques to say,
"Stop it, O our Lord!" No one is running to churches to say, "O our Lord! Stop that cursing on us!" Where are
the holy people? Where are the religious people? Why are they not saying anything? Now, the Muslim world's
only focus is to say, "We must save Palestinians!" What is that? Does it take all nations to free Palestinians?
They are free!! Why are you not looking from east to west, and from north to south? Shaytan is making their
attention only on one square foot of space. There are five billion or more people and you are only focusing on
one million people! What is that? Where is Islam? Is there no wisdom from Islam? Where are our religious
people, and the holy people from Christianity, and the holy rabbis from Jerusalem? What are they doing?

People are so proud, saying, "We have power." Use your power now! "Yes, we are using nuclear power." Yes,
use what you can (if you have so much power)! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Come to your real understanding, don’t run after Shaytan. Shaytan is calling you to be destroyed in
fire here and Hereafter. May Allah forgive us.
O People! Safar is a terrible month, coming with power. Of the twelve months it is the most terrible. Events
are going to appear, and it has only been one week and this power is coming; I don't know what is coming
behind it. May Allah Almighty forgive us, and send us a sultan to destroy Shaytan's sultanate, for the honor of
the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
